Summary: [S3][Both] 联调「漂移告警 -> 人工审批再训练 -> 上线」及「坏模型回滚」完整演练并存档证据 #3
Description:
h3. Goal

*Owner:* Both | *Reviewer:* Tech Lead | *Dependencies:* #15, #16

h3. Target Files
* .github/workflows/retrain-hitl.yml
* docs/evidence/03_drift_and_rollback.md

{code}

* [ ] 真实跑通一次坏模型回滚，且全程耗时与恢复证据记录完备
